source: wave1/STYLE-TEMPLATES.md — extracted 2026-10-14 from the owner's inspiration library (images/cxema/art listed files + chat attachments + .media intro-logo)
rules: NO text, letters, numbers or logos in generated pixels — the Schema mark is composited afterwards
barcode-on-people: plain bars on neck/palm/wrist, sometimes, digits composited by us
red is the only saturated colour; everything else desaturated
LOGO LAW: never paste the logo — corner mark, text lockup, or GENERATED IN only (video = re-clip with logo in start frame; still = img2img/Kontext regen that eats our logo and the generation)
